title: CounterUpdate payload
description: Typed payload for the counter-update operation kind (registry code 7). Apply a signed delta to a counter field over a valid-time interval (CRDT, convergent under merge). Fields are grounded in crates/mneme_core/src/ops.rs::CounterUpdateInput, rendered in canonical contract names. Encoded per the canonical-JSON profile: all fields present, absent optionals as null, UUIDs lower-case hyphenated, HLC, valid times, and the full-range i64 delta as decimal strings, layer as a stable lower name.

delta.description: Signed full-range i64 increment applied to the counter, as a decimal string.

hlc.description: Full-range HLC coordinate as a decimal string (canonical-JSON profile).

validTime.description: ValidTime as epoch microseconds UTC, encoded as a decimal string.

layer.description: Layer value tag as a stable schema-owned lower name.
